active_pipeline_integration: Gemini: preserve version/withdrawal status and prevent withdrawn advantage claims becoming supporting proof evidence.

records.title: Quantum Advantage via Solving Multivariate Quadratics
records.evidence_read: Author arXiv version2 withdrawal comment, not a reconstruction of the classical attack.
records.mechanism: Proposed specified quadratic systems as a replacement for a random oracle in quantum-advantage constructions.
records.problem_family: Specified underdetermined binary quadratic systems, not arbitrary MQ or native DCP carry quotients.
records.reduction: The earlier abstract connects the proposal to Yamakawa-Zhandry; this audit does not verify that construction.
records.no_go_barrier: Authors withdrew after being informed of a classical attack. The advertised classical-hardness separation cannot support a project speedup claim.
records.proof_technique: Not audited: withdrawal does not imply the quantum algorithm's proofs are false.
records.open_question: Determine the actual attack and which source structures made the proposed separation vulnerable, before borrowing its abstractions.
records.reusable_abstraction: Keep algorithm correctness, classical hardness, source distribution, version status and novelty as separate obligations.

records.title: Algorithm for Solving Massively Underdefined Systems of Multivariate Quadratic Equations over Finite Fields
records.evidence_read: Abstract only; theorem assumptions and full implementation have not been independently audited.
records.mechanism: Classical underdetermined MQ reduction using finite-field square roots and guess-and-determine.
records.problem_family: Quadratic systems over finite fields in a strongly underdetermined regime.
records.reduction: Author-claimed characteristic-two polynomial regime has at least m(m+1)/2 variables for m equations; do not transfer it to higher-degree carry graphs.
records.no_go_barrier: Polynomial first-layer MQ solution is already a classical baseline; higher quotients need not remain quadratic.
records.proof_technique: Author-described square-root reduction; full proof review remains outstanding.
records.open_question: Can an explicitly source-correct higher-carry representation admit a comparable classical reduction without silently changing its degree or domain?
records.reusable_abstraction: Record equations, variables, field characteristic, algebraic degree, solution distribution and inverse/ranking requirements separately.

records.title: Primitive spaces of matrices with upper rank two over the field with two elements
records.evidence_read: Sections5.2 and5.3, especially the irreducible two-dimensional companion-matrix example and binary affine nonsingular spaces.
records.mechanism: Nonsingular affine matrix pencils from trivial-spectrum matrix spaces over F2.
records.problem_family: Binary matrix-space geometry; possible low-bit fiber pivot blocks, not a DCP algorithm.
records.reduction: For invertible M0, test the translated pencil through M0^-1 times its variation space; nonsingularity is not equivalent to a constant matrix.
records.no_go_barrier: An abstract nonsingular pencil does not prove its native-source prevalence, growing-q extension or carry-recursion closure.
records.proof_technique: Classification of small binary matrix spaces and their trivial spectra.
records.open_question: Can a constructible native low-label chart induce a useful nonsingular pencil without exponentially rare signatures or an inverse-degree explosion?
records.reusable_abstraction: Separate constant-pivot radical obstructions, nonsingular varying pencils, source mass and complete decoder success.

records.title: Large affine spaces of non-singular matrices
records.evidence_read: Abstract field-size qualification only; no full classification transfer.
records.mechanism: Classification of maximal-dimensional affine nonsingular matrix spaces.
records.problem_family: Fields with at least three elements in the stated classification.
records.reduction: Background context for the dedicated binary-field source above.
records.no_go_barrier: Do not import a field-size-qualified classification into F2 without a separate theorem.
records.open_question: Which field-size-specific hypotheses matter for the actual binary pivot source?
records.reusable_abstraction: Treat field characteristic and field cardinality as independent theorem applicability checks.
